newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Golf - Woods moves to two par under behind leader Parsons.
newsitem.headline: Golf - Woods moves to two par under behind leader Parsons.

text.p: American golf sensation Tiger Woods has moved to two under par in pursuit of leader Lucas Parson at the A$750,000 Australian Masters tournament at Huntingdale.
Parsons led the local challenge by equalling the course record with a first round 64, nine under par, in fine conditions.
Woods, the overwhelming tournament favourite, birdied the par-five sixth to move up the leaderboard.
Australian Peter O'Malley is second on eight under after 18 holes.
